title: GenAI fictional field study and user interviews
summary: Design teams conduct simulated user interviews with GenAI midway through a tangible-interaction project set in the fictional world Rheta. Students define the world, product, scenario, and persona, conduct the interview, generate an accompanying image, and use the responses to reflect on their design.

sources.title: Use of Generative AI for Fictional Field Studies in Design Courses

locator.section: 2. The Exercise of Using Generative AI for Field Studies

sources.evidence_quote: The students got the exercise to do field study and user interviews half-way through the larger project work.

assessment.summary: Use a GenAI persona to simulate a field-study interview about a physical-digital object being developed by the team.
student_actions: Describe the fictional world and physical-digital object to GenAI.
Specify a user scenario and persona.
Generate an image of the user scenario or interview.
Use the feedback to reflect on and refine the design.

student_role.description: Students prompt GenAI to role-play a persona and answer interview questions about the team's design.

reported_results: All four teams completed the activity.
Teams reported new design perspectives, but also overly positive and sometimes inconsistent AI responses.
